overview: The Driftwood Spars is an inn with 15 en-suite rooms at Trevaunance Cove, just below St Agnes village, with its own brewery, two bars and a sea-view restaurant. It sits a short walk from the cove and the South West Coast Path. Note it is in St Agnes, not Perranporth. The building is a 17th-century slate and stone pub that has served as a tin-mine warehouse, ship's chandlery and sail loft, and it has hosted many surfers over the years.
surfTripFit: Trevaunance Cove is on the doorstep and guests booking the B&B get a guaranteed parking space for their stay, making it handy for St Agnes surf and a short drive to Perranporth or Porthtowan.
